model.selector_help:
DASIWA H3 HYBRID TURBO V3 — REFERENCES (EXPERIMENTAL)
Use ordered image, video, and audio references. Turbo is baked into the checkpoint: start at 8 Euler steps, with 4–8 denoising steps available. Do not add another Turbo or PDD accelerator.
Frames and References share one pinned 21 GB pruned INT8 ConvRot checkpoint, with synchronized audio. Downloads come directly from the creator on Civitai and use the key in Settings > Services.
